findings.title: Profile Update Endpoint Missing Caller Verification
findings.description: The POST /api/profile/update endpoint validates authorization header but does not verify that the caller can only modify their own profile. The imported canModifyProfile() helper function is never invoked. Without JWT-based caller identity, any authenticated user can modify another user's profile by providing their username in the request body.
findings.consequence: Unauthorized profile modification - User A could modify User B's email or password if User B's username is known.
findings.fixImplemented: Line 109: canModifyProfile() check is now invoked to verify users can only modify their own profile. Unauthorized access returns 403 Forbidden with detailed error message.
findings.evidence: const isAuthorized = canModifyProfile({ username: dbUser.username, nama: dbUser.nama, role: dbUser.role }, username) with proper error handling

findings.title: Add User Endpoint Does Not Enforce Staff-Only Restriction
findings.description: Requirement: 'Tambah pengguna untuk akun staf saja' (Add users for staff accounts only). The endpoint imports canAddUsers() but never calls it. Authorization header is validated but caller's role is not checked. Any authenticated user can bypass the UI and directly call the API to add users.
findings.consequence: Privilege escalation - Lurah or admin users can call the API directly to bypass the staff-only restriction and create users.
findings.fixImplemented: Lines 89-110: callerRole validation is now implemented. Client passes callerRole from authenticated session. API calls canAddUsers(callerRole) and returns 403 Forbidden if not authorized. Verification occurs before any database operations.
findings.evidence: if (!canAddUsers(callerRole)) with proper authorization check and audit logging

findings.title: Add User API Accepts Admin Role Despite UI Restriction
findings.description: The add-user form UI (src/app/admin/add-user/page.tsx) only allows selecting 'staf' or 'lurah' roles. However, the API endpoint (src/app/api/admin/users/add/route.ts lines 50-57) accepts 'admin' role in validation. Direct API calls can create admin accounts, bypassing UI restrictions.
findings.consequence: Unauthorized admin account creation through direct API calls outside the UI.
findings.fixImplemented: Line 54: Changed role validation from !['staf', 'lurah', 'admin'].includes(role) to !['staf', 'lurah'].includes(role). Error message updated to 'Role hanya dapat staf atau lurah'.

fixSummary.recommendations: Implementation is production-ready. Consider JWT implementation in future for enhanced token-based identity verification.
